snippet.title: A Shock Of Dimension full gameplay 2  - SAGE 2026
snippet.description:
Inspired by 32-bit classics (PS1/Sega Saturn) such as NiGHTS into Dreams , Spyro , and Ace Combat.

Get in a magic world and test your habilities in this high speed adventure of chase & escape!

Game: A Shock of Dimension
demo available : https://plrosario-interactive.itch.io/a-shock-of-dimension
